review: First support guy was great, but 2nd time had to wait for ages on online chat and gave up. I did however get an email reply eventually but I didn't understand it. Overall, the site is a bit clunky and many of the afternoon tea experiences I was interested in booking made no mention of extra fees payable on top of the voucher ( not even in the small print section).

title: Payment system unsatisfactory
review: I thought the selection of gifts on offer and the prices were extremely good. Y complaint was around the payment system which having opted for payment with a LLoyds MasterCard put me through to something which resembled a dodgy provider something like "hook..."  and pushed me through to what  I assumed was a Lloyds page asking for confirmation of the payment. This we did but the order was not competed and a further oider had to be placed.

review: The information of some of the experiences is inadequate especially with regard to locations.Buy a Gift have decided not to help customers by email any more, which is not very helpful forthose who have a limited speech disabillity.I wanted to email them about a disappearingcredit which i though would run alongside anexperience I purchased with a use by date of 2025 only to find the credit was available to use only untilMarch 2024.  My loss I suppose.  I cannot recommend Buy a Gift for this reason.

review: Not overly impressed! review: Good speedy delivery but I’ve got someone else’s gift!! So far been unable to contact customer services. Really poor.so disappointed. However I was able to contact later and received the best help possible.

title: Incorrect use of PayPal
review: I wanted to order a basic two day hotel break as a gift. I chose to send this myself and then send it on, although when the card arrived it appeared to think it was a gift from someone else to me. However, the gift I wanted was on the first page and it was easy select it and make the order. Delivery was fast. Marks deducted as Buyagift have PayPal as a payment option but instead of choosing this as soon as you select your gift, and thus allowing PayPal to fill in your address details, Buyagift forces you to enter your address first, before selecting PayPal as payment method. Extremely annoying when companies do this, makes using PayPal far less convenient. Two stars off for wasting my time.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: Easy to order, still waiting for voucher in the post
review: It was easy enough to order, and it seems a very good price for the experience, although as it's a Christmas gift, I can't comment further at this point.  But I ordered it to come in the post with an envelope for presentation, and this hasn't arrived yet  (4 days since I ordered), so I'm still waiting for this.  If all else fails, I have donwloaded the pdf which came with the confirmation.

Not sure whose error this was but your website should have identified the difference between to the two items ordered and asked if this was correct.

title: Shambolic
review: The two gift experiences I ordered didn’t get delivered to the recipient. I had paid extra for next day delivery. No tracking service provided. Very poor service. Customer service were great and they resent the vouchers and these were received the next day. But it was 7 days late and missed their birthday.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: The price is way over the actual cost…
review: The price is way over the actual cost of the reservation if we book direct. £128 as opposed to £75!Our first booking was  not confirmed -  but nor were we advised of any problem. It simply disappeared and the provisional credit card charge was not taken. We could have assumed that it was booked.Also, the information about the hotels was sparse and inadequate.Altogether poor.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: The booking experience is terrible
review: The booking experience is terrible! Difficulty placing the order and I agree with other users, it would be better to receive the money instead. The booking process takes so long, what you want is always more expensive, the filters aren't very good when searching and you can't call Buy A Gift for guidance, you have to sit waiting for ages on WebChat. I then had to email the hotel booking team (wouldn't accept telephone booking) and received an automated reply saying they will get back to me within 5 days!!! Shocking!Saying that, I myself have bought these as gifts as an easy option but I won't be doing this again knowing what a snail pace headache it is for the recipient!

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: The price is the problem
review: The price is the problem! Tried to book afternoon tea in Oxfordshire which is available at a nearby hotel for £21 per person if you book direct with the hotel.Using a byagift voucher for £35 and I am asked to pay another £16.99 for the same thing. £52 instead of £42.Also the search facility on the website is poor. If you use their regional locations it gives you a list of venues bunched together in no particular order.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: Disappointed with available seats
review: Disappointed with available seats. Last row in the grand circle. Next time, I’ll go to a specific theatre website. The upgrade prices are ridiculous. The reviews highlighted that good seats are available from the package which was why I selected it and with the Christmas discount made it a good deal. However, not great seats to take someone out for their birthday. Hugely disappointing.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: Changing terms of offers with no warning
review: I regularly use this site and have found it to be very good but disappointed today. I received a £15 discount code after a purchase I made on Saturday to be used on any experience. The email clearly stated the code was valid for two weeks. Upon trying to use it today it said code invalid. I contacted customer services who said the code was only valid for 24 hours. I showed her the email where it says two weeks and was told that the terms have since been changed to 24 hours. I think it’s a real shame that I wasn’t notified of this change of terms or I would have used the voucher immediately. I know they can withdraw offers at any time and change terms but it doesn’t seem fair they didn’t give me an opportunity to use the voucher. It’s really put me off using the site.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: Only way to redeem voucher is to email…
review: Only way to redeem voucher is to email Toca and await a response (up to 48 hours). When they responded our chosen time wasn't available and an alternative time was offered, we said yes but no confirmation and another 48 hour wait to see if they do which cuts it very fine. If you are buying be aware you'll need to book way in advance.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: Gift Experiences Good..Administration Awful
review: I have used Buyagift many times over the years but won't do again.I purchased a spa day for a friend but the voucher noted the wrong location therein. The Buyagift website does not include any means of contacting the company via either phone or e-mail, only a beyond irritating chatbot which sends you round in circles without ever coming close to answering your query.Ended up completing a complaint form, subsequent to which I received an e-mail requesting information. I was very bluntly told that the chatbot had improved their customer service, a frankly risible statement.Sent an image of the voucher, only to told there was nothing wrong with it. The lady concerned must have been blind. Have since been asked for the same information again and, a month on, the issue still hasn't been resolved. I am concerned that my friend will attempt to book the spa day, only to be declined owing to the incorrect voucher.To summarise, by all means use Buyagift if you assume that all will progress without problems. However, if you have any concerns about post-purchase issues and an aversion to appalling administration, my advice is to go elsewhere.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: Do not use this company, terrible customer service
review: This is the second voucher I have been given to book an experience via buy a gift. Don’t touch this company. The first voucher was false advertising stating a meal was included with the experience until we got there and it actually had some money towards the meal and it cost us a load more money on the day. Now, my next voucher is a nightmare as you cannot get customer services only via chatbot and there is no option for what you need. It stated 13 minutes to be connected to a human being, 24 hours later still not connected. There is nowhere to raise a complaint when you try you get chatbot and again no option to complain and no phone number. It is not a good company and I would advise you to steer clear.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: Not good value for money as far as…
review: Not good value for money as far as Afternoon Tea is concerned. I believe that at the time of purchasing the voucher Birmingham location option was their offering at Hilton, but this option wasn’t available at the time of booking. The other locations specified weren’t good value for the amount paid.

description: Buyagift is the UK's leading provider of gift experiences, unique gift ideas and fabulous traditional gifts - all at great prices. Find the perfect gift for every taste and budget here!
title: Afternoon tea experience
review: I bought the afternoon tea for my dad for Christmas. We then scanned the QR code to choose where we would go, it sent us to a site which had many options however, only a couple were included in the price I paid which wasn’t made clear to me when I had bought the experience. To go to any decent place, you have to pay an additional price, which to me seems unfair as I was not informed earlier. We haven’t visited the place we picked, however this has ruined my whole experience.

They theoretically list what is excluded from the 5% discount right under the product price, but then everything that is not listed as excluded will still not receive the discount. I was never able to redeem a discount and don't understand this marketing strategy. It turns excitement into frustration and a non-purchase for feeling tricked.I simply have to subtract stars for such decisions even if I generally like your store for some of the bundles.

title: Think twice before purchasing - Unreal Engine 5 Codebase Collection: Essential Snippets for Pro Developers
review: Before reviewing, I would like to thank you for giving me the opportunity to purchase contents at a low price via Fanatical. However, the content of "Unreal Engine 5 Codebase Collection: Essential Snippets for Pro Developers" offered by Mammoth Interactive was too shocking. The product, which original price is $99.00, contains only one compressed file without any instruction. The compressed file contains five text files, the contents of which are copies of the Unreal Engine Blueprints in text format and are not human-readable. Additionally, because Unreal Engine has many different types of Blueprints, it is impossible to know which type of Blueprint to copy and paste text content into. If the purpose was to at least provide a blueprint, it should have been in project form.

description: Great deals on Formula 1, MotoGP and WEC tickets for the entire season. All Grand Prix practices, special packages and events.
title: Friendly service but the whole system of redeeming vouchers is broken
review: I tried to redeem vouchers gifted to me as a present. But there are a couple of problems with how this works:1. Your allocation of tickets seem to sell out too quickly, meaning any voucher gifted may not be able to be used until the following year's event.2. The vouchers have a (in my opinion) very short expiry. Although you are very good at extending the expiry date upon request, it's just a hassle to have to remember to contact you to do this.3. Your allocation of tickets from F1 occurs many weeks after they go on sale publicly.  So there is a risk that if i am able to buy locally and then you have sufficient allocation to use my vouchers, then i am left with twice as many tickets as i need (at considerable cost). Alternatively, i could end up with no tickets if I decide to wait for your allocation but your allocation is exhausted. So it becomes very stressful to know whether i should duplicate my purchase or risk missing out completely. Not good.4. When your allocation of tickets become available, I cannot redeem my voucher/s unless i have a UK address. So this means having to contact you by email by which time your allocation could be exhausted.  Again, very stressful.So overall although your customer service team are very obliging and very friendly, your whole system just doesn't work well, causing stress and concern to the customer.

review: The Les Mis Spectacular is just that, spectacular! Fantastic show, with an amazing cast, only let down by Newcastle’s dreadfully outdated arena! £80-£90 to sit on small, hard plastic seats for 4hrs is a little insulting.

review: Abba Voyage is a must it’s an excellent show but the venue and staff are amazingThey are happy dancing and polite which is not often the case at other venuesEasy to get to via DLR We used the little bar outside for food and drink beforehand all cooked to order and a glitter bar for those who want some glam plus a dance floor for your warm up moves

review: Brilliant,  everything went smoothly and constantly informed through e mails regarding updates for event. Show was absolutely fantastic, the cast were brilliant, well worth the money and wait

review: Excellent service offered by Ticketmaster. Only needed to screenshot QR e-tickets and show these at the arena. Also very clear instructions provided which made it a very enjoyable evening with no stress. Many thanks.

review: We went to see Les Miserable at The arena spectacular at Gateshead , everything was ran well from security to food and drinks . description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.

review: Ticketmaster are good about keeping you informed with details about the show booked and if there is anything that you need help with they are there for you. review: My husband and I required assistance at arena. We were met by medics who took us to our seats snd when the show finished they assisted us back to our daughters car. Nothing was to much trouble. The show was amazing and we can't wait to visit again!! Well done everyone

review: the bootleg Beatles were again amazing, a different show every year,the theatre itself has always had a sound quality second to none and the staff polite and courteous very professional.unfortunately as is the norm at most venues the prices for drinks etc are extravagant.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Abba voyage a great night out
review: I bought the tickets for Abba Voyage from Ticketmaster. I used the Ticketmaster app to gain entry to the event. The app was easy to use. The venue was great clean and well laid out. The show itself was spectacular and was a brilliant night. The staff at the venue were very friendly and encouraged audience participation waving arms etc. A great night

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Easy to buy our tickets
review: Easy to buy our tickets.  When the app updated I was worried I would lose the tickets, but thank goodness no errors! Not an issue from Ticketmaster, but paid for insurance had to email to get insurance policy from company, weeks later with no apologies why I had not received it from them, appeared the policy in my inbox.  At the arena the tickets in my google wallet did not work, told to go to the box office for paper tickets, which we did, then entered venue with no further issue.  Quite happy with paper tickets as I now have a keepsake of the event!

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Brilliant performance
review: Brilliant performance. The only pointers would be:(a) often the cast were looking out into the audience rather than looking at each-other - which seemed odd.  (b) drinks prices - disgraceful.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: An easy booking process.
review: The booking process was really easy and gave very detailed explanations of seating plans etc. The only reason that I didn’t give 5 stars, is because I felt pressured by Ticketmaster to download their app. I was inundated with messages from them inferring that if I did not have the app I might not be able to get into the venue. This was quite annoying!

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Les Miserables through good UnderstudiesEnjoyed the show
review: Enjoyed the show - although very disappointed not to have Alfie Boe & Michael Ball performing - apparently they had performed the evening before, Friday 3rd January, but not Saturday 4th January! I bought the tickets in July 2024 to see Boe & Ball performing, however had no notification to say they would be absent from the show! I have also read a few other reviews from people who have had the same complaint.

review: A well organised venie and event.  It did not effect me, but if we had gone the day before when it was pouring with rain it would have been a different matter.  Perhaps a covered event would be better.  One disappointement was the condiontion of the ice.  It was very uneven and made for difficult skating.  A better ice management should be considered for similar events in the future.

All throughout the show I thought they may do a change, then I thought they may show them sell in the show finally and maybe do a song but no. Please keep this in mind before going to the show as a wouldn't like to see another les miserables fan be disappointed. Les rocks is the worst saying to to be put on the merchandise in my opinion. I still bought a few things.

The concert overall was excellent with superb singers and actors.However, some  people were disappointed with not seeing Boe and Ball since nowhere in the ticket purchases did it mention when this duo were performing in Les Miserables?  Can this be rectified in future? For other shows this is done eg Grease and Sister Act in London!

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Amazing acoustics !
review: Service at the venue was excellent. Friday’s performance was amazing. The cast was unbelievable and the acoustics in the arena were as crystal clear. I purchased tickets in December 23 and then found out that Alfie Boe would be performing on the Sunday afternoon so bought more tickets. Disappointed as I found out from a member of the audience that Alfie wouldn’t be  performing. Very upset crowd at the news of this. Excellent customer service at the AO arena.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Mostly good but some things not great
review: Thought most things were great but, from my point of view as an older lady, the rather vertiginous steps - without handrails -  to the seats were a bit of a challenge in both directions... My husband also found the seats rather hard and uncomfortable, especially for that length of performance - he was looking forward to the end of the show so that he could move. Hence, one star deducted. But otherwise really enjoyed the experience and the helpers were very good.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.

I booked these tickets specifically as SF on as they came on sale as both Michael Ball and Alfie Boe were performing together. I  m understand things happen and people fall ill but to not mention it at the venue is unacceptable

Sound effects good but rather loud which distorted the singing. No sets like a therater but not really a problem.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: All very streamlined and no problems in…
review: All very streamlined and no problems in what was a great night out and a wonderful experience. I found the reminders and prompts very helpful.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: The slickness and welcoming and…
review: The slickness and welcoming and friendly staff for hospitality lounge was brilliant. Unfortunately they missed humour table out for ordering when we sat down which lead to our meal being rushed and me still chewing my food as we were moved to our seat. Saying that, once we told a manager he made sure we were served and apologised a lot. He was great. The food was absolutely top notch and beautiful. We had our desert during the interval. As everything was so nice I won’t hold it against them!! We had a great experience and felt very special in the end. Ticketmaster could explain a bit more on the hospitality ticket about where and when to enter to avoid the rush for the meal. Even though it is slick. I didn’t really know how it would work or which part to go to with my elderly mum.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Fantastic show, venu seating awful
review: Fantastic show, all cast super singers.Issues with block B seating offered very poor visibility of the stage and lack of space between rows and those sitting either side of you made this a very uncomfortable few hours. Never been to a show where seating so bad in terms of view and lack of space. My wife only able to see utilizing the large video screens and I having to head dodge those in front of me to see and a lot unseen unless also using the video screens. Seating spoilt the overall experience tbh. Will not book floor seating again if I ever come back to Newcastle Arena.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Unfair seating for disabled people
review: I attended as companion with my sister who is profoundly deaf. Unfortunately all disabled seating is grouped together on the SIDE which is not good for visually or hearing impaired. You should he able to book any seat easily anywhere in the venue as able bodied people can and take a companion. We loved the show despite this tho. Generally, it is hard for disabled people to book but it should be easier.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Why App only tickets!
review: If you expect people to use your App to show the tickets at venues, then please ensure the Wifi is decent enough at these venues to cope with additional traffic. Numerous people struggling at Newcastle last night!

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.

review: Had trouble booking tickets, trying to book 3, but when in checkout only 2 were showing. Kept going back and forth and eventually managed it. On the night realised I had mistakenly booked an earlier show and so had to pay for more tickets with no way to contact ticket master about it ? The venue weren’t interested so a waste of money !

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Money gouging
review: Money gouging. As usual the ticket face value means nothing due to the avalanche of unavoidable extra charges levied by ticketmaster. Sure the app sorts of works adequately but the lack of choice is galling and takes the enjoyment out of the booking process

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Average experience
review: Far too many e mail reminders about the event leading up to it.....remember we used to buy a paper ticket and retain it until entry.....that was it in the good old days.....easy to obtain the dcticket in my wallet though.....we simply do not need multiple reminders sent to us..

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Allow VPN support for security
review: Impossible to use Ticketmaster with a VPN connection. I always use a VPN when connecting through any public wifi (such as most concert/other event venues) for security.Seems crazy that Ticketmaster force me to be unsecure and disconnect the VPN just to get their app working to show my tickets to the door staff to get in.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Ticketmaster App does not work at the venue!?
review: The Ticketmaster App works at all times except at the venue. We had to go to the ticket office to have ticket printed, though this is not very good. I wonder why!Despite the above, the Les Mis Show was brilliant and top class for Les Mis fans like us !!

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Drenched at London NY Day ParadeThe worry associated with not getting…
review: The worry associated with not getting access to my tickets until the last minute was unnecessary.  Althing the heavy rain was unavoidable, the front row seating in the VIP grandstands was miserable.  The covering did not cover Row 1 completely so we were literally drenched 1/2 way through the parade.In my seat (Row 1, Seat 18) the runoff   from the water hitting pooling on the tent covering pored directly into my seat.  I missed portions of parade trying to divert it with my umbrella.  By parades end, 3 layers of clothing were drenched.  The parade officials said they would contact TicketMasters UK about refunding the price of the 2 tickets.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Ticket scanning difficulties
review: Despite adding my ticket to my wallet as advised, staff at the Arena were unable to scan despite repeated attempts. Luckily a very kind member of staff told me that they sometimes had issues with ticketmaster tickets and allowed me to enter.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: New App
review: Not sure about the new app- could have more info like floorplans, venue opening times & facilities. Booking fees are a con

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Bought front row tickets but were…
review: Bought front row tickets but were facing a big part of the stage that wasn’t being used so had to sit twisted. The view I would say was partial from where we were. Also a really large lady sat next to me and took up half my seat. She should have paid for two seats as she clearly needed it. It was so uncomfortable and I don’t like other people touching me or sharing my space. I have a bad back anyway so this really wasn’t ideal sitting in this position and made worse by the lady next to me, couldn’t even get my arms in by my side.The show was and sounded fantastic for the bit I could see though and would highly recommend. I would love to see it properly though with a better view. I bought the tickets over a year in advance too thinking our seats would be amazing but was very disappointed.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: The ice skating is well organised and…
review: Ice skating at Battersea power station: The ice skating is well organised and easy to navigate, the reason I have only given it 3 stars is because the girls and boys serving you your ice skating boots can not bring themselves to look at you or acknowledge you.  My 12 year old son mentioned to me that he had noticed it because it made him feel uncomfortable.  When I made a point of saying "thank you" to the girl bringing back my daughter's shoes but she just looked at me like I had 2 heads!! Politeness is free and it makes for a more pleasant experience all round.  When you receive good customer service you remember the experience and you feel really good about spending the money. Perhaps as a matter of course, whilst in training, this could be pointed out to the people serving the public.  I had driven from Norfolk to experience the ice skating at Battersea so perhaps it's a location thing but I STRONGLY don't think so as manners are global.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Scanner changes
review: Complaint about utilita arena, they changed their scanners recently and are not compatible with ticketmaster bar codes Total shambles

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Disappointed
review: Disappointed, as when booked tickets 11month ago we were lead to believe there was only one show at Manchester and BOTH Alfie Boe and Michael Ball would be performing on that day (29th Dec) Although the cast was good we wanted to see Alfie Boe as well and that was the reason for booking (like many others we spoke to)I also wish the venue could manage to install some type of handrail or hand post as it is very steep and dangerous. ( I did actually fall on these stairs yesterday)

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Painful website lately !
review: Website forever asking to create a new password , often unable to gain access. Tried to transfer tickets to my Husband for safety on his phone but he couldn't access his account either !! Lots of people in the ticket resolution queue , luckily our tickets worked on my phone !

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Frustrating experience
review: Frustrating experience. Numerous e-mails to advise that we should download our tickets to our Google Wallet (or similar), only to find the venue couldn't scan them this way and we had to log into the Ticketmaster app.We weren't alone in this issue, a lot of people ended up in the same boat.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Christmas rocks night 2
review: Christmas rocks night 2 had a good line up of bands and the bands themselves performed brilliantly,  but unfortunately the sound quality of the whole gig was very poor. The music was much louder than the vocals making it very hard to hear the singer, and at times there was high pitched interference. It was a great shame and we hope the sound issue will be rectified for future performances.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.

review: The seats in block 301 were too squashed together couldn’t be comfortable also no leg room spoiled the experience, also only booked to see Michael ball and Alfie boe and assumed they would singing we were at evening of 4th January Newcastle and they’d been on matinee

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.

review: We have seen Jack on previous occasions and found him hilarious.  This time, however, we were not impressed with his smutty jokes, frequent use of the F word and even the C word.  This was not funny nor necessary and felt he had let himself down.  The addition of his parents with their cringe worthy behaviour was in very poor taste. Very disappointed.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: It was not organized in a safe way
review: It was not organized in a safe way. The event was beautiful but very dangerous because of the gates at the entrance. People started queuing at 5 pm and they weren’t allowed to go in until 8 pm. When they opened the gates everybody Just started running and pushing and it was very dangerous. Never again

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: This event was the hugest…
review: This event was the hugest disappointment . We live in Amersham, I have seen Les mis 13 times with all key leads and the 25th arena tour in London. I have never seen Michael Ball and Alfie Boe together performing in Les Mis so it was so excited to book this arena tour , sadly the nearest venue for us was Manchester! We decided to do it and complete my dream cast. At huge cost we booked a special night including hotel and the so called champagne experience! This was our experience ….Half a champagne glass of Lanson on entry to a very low key electric lounge…The plate of nibbles was hugely generous for meat eaters.The vegetarian option a sad production of humus, cous cous , stale bread, cold burnt sweet potato and very strange smelling stuffed vine leaves shocking value! To finish our experience off neither  Michael or Alfie were appearing on this production ( this was my entire and only reason for booking ) how can this be managed better to avoid disappointment in the future and a total expenditure of £500 ?

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Incomplete event info
review: Ticketmaster only stated 11.30 on their page/tickets for this event. No mention that this was doors open time and that the show would be starting later so we had to stand outside in the freezing wind waiting for the doors to open and then wait inside for an hour and a half before the show began (well actually 2 hours because it started late but that was the venues fault). Very poor communication from ticketmaster

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.

review: Buying the tickets was easy and straightforward but day before the event no digital tickets they were supposed to be available 5 days before the event in the venue App so contacted ticket master for help with this and this is where we was let down couldn’t speak to a real person just a online chat which ended up stating you have to take it up with o2 venue and the chat was ended by ticket master without any help. Customer service is awful

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Won’t be rushing back
review: Finding our seats was not easy. Distinct lack of signpostingWaited for 25 minutes in long queues for food and drinks. Prices were very high There was no notification and we were completely unaware there was entertainment on stage before the show started and we missed it allAnd finally car parking charges are ridiculously expensive at £12Not surprised there were so many empty seats. A very expensive family night out. Won’t be rushing back

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.
title: Overcrowded and Stressful Skating Experience
review: I was really looking forward to enjoying a fun ice skating experience at Glide, but unfortunately, it fell short of expectations. The biggest issue was the overcrowding. There were far too many people crammed into a relatively small rink, making it feel chaotic and unsafe.It was hard to skate properly without bumping into others, and the lack of space made it more stressful than enjoyable. For beginners or anyone hoping for a relaxed experience, this is definitely not ideal. It felt more like a free-for-all than a controlled or well-organized event.I’d suggest the organizers limit the number of people on the ice at any given time for everyone’s safety and enjoyment. As it stands, I wouldn’t recommend it unless you’re very confident on the ice and okay with navigating through crowds.

description: Ticketmaster: All your entertainment needs under one virtual roof with tickets for theatre, concerts, sport, family events, clubs and more.

We would not have booked had we have known. We are very disappointed and feel we were mislead at the point of sale.

title: A mixed bag
review: So we visited Sunderland empire to watch jack and the beanstalk  and booked tickets for the ambassador lounge. Upon arrival we were shown to our table and pippa did a great job of taking our drinks order and explaining how we could leave our things in the lounge and go and watch the show. All was going well, then we were told the show was going g to start and to make our way to our seats. We weren’t told there was a quicker route to our seats, we discovered that at the interval. We also were unsure of what was included in our package, it wasn’t very clear. Also when it was time to leave we returned to the lounge to get our belongings and to use the toilet before we set off and there was a young unhelpful member of staff who stood there looking glum. We were wondering which way to exit and she offered no assistance. She then did a little woop of excitement to another member of staff after we left. Made us feel rushed and like a burden. The ambassador lounge is such a good idea, but needs more staff like pippa who are friendly informative and welcoming!

Once seated, my seat was broken and it was so uncomfortable to sit in there for 3h. When you pay 150£ for two tickets and everything goes wrong and you cannot even control it.. it's quite frustrating. To be honest, I felt scammed. It is like buying a ticket for the concert of your favourite artist and in the end it's just a knock of band on stage and no one told you about it. Deceiving. title: It really depends...
review: I went to the summer school three times in a row, and the lady running it was the same lady every year. She seemed to focus the a lot of time on fitness and other things, and she was quite uncompassionate and rather unempathetic, as if she was just being paid to do the job and was in it for the money. When we performed our productions, she was always very non-interprative, and with her as the director, she would not allow us to put our own spin and interpretation into the role, but we would have to perform exactly how she said, when she said it, and she would get unreasonable when we asked her about the script and how to do things.Yes I understand that she was meant to be the director of the summer production, but I dont think a director is meant to be rock solid in her opinions, as firm as steel and unsympathetic, especially towards a group of 20 7-10 year olds. I don't think that she was the right woman for the job, and my summer weeks with her were not the most enjoyable, but the thought of performing made me carry on. So yes that is my experience, now being older looking back, I wouldn't choose to spend my money on it, but I think that if I'd had a different teacher, I would have had a more enjoyable experience.PROS: cheap uniform, have centres all across the country so the sessions are fully accessible to anyone in any location. Also, do choose relatively good and well-known plays to performCONS: Quality of the sessions depends on the teacher, are known to be fussy with money, sessions can be interpretive based on teacher's opinions and qualities.

title: I have recently left stage coach
review: I have recently left stage coach and joined PQA this Saturday that was the best decision ever I'm already in a friend group and feel like a apart of the team.At stage coach for me it felt like there was favouritism and it made me lose my confidence and enjoyment in acting. The students there treated me childishly because of my disability and I felt awkward the whole time as non of them really wanted to talk to me. I only made one friend there who is lovely and trying to gain herself confidence but when she joined non of them went up to her or introduced themselfs her saying "they was busy talking when I walked over that's why I wasn't talking to them" I don't know if it's to do with her being black but I would be the only person to talk to her and to interact with her unless one of the others was made to work with her. I hope she gets more confidence and one of them or someone new will join and talk to her and be her friend. At a easter school I think it was a 10 year old kid kept touching my bottom and touched my boobs that stressed me out the coach saying its because of his disability but then the parents should of taught that kid to not even touch people's personal parts this triggers me thinking about it and he only would do it when staff wasn't playing attention so he knew what he was doing was wrong but a pupil did notice and told the kid off. I don't want anything to be done im just giving honest review now that I'm at PQA and I feel way more confident and more apart compared to at stage coach and I think I found my group of people in a what's app group with 5 other people and join them in actives to where at stage coach I would sit alone before the girl at stage coach joined and it would just be me and her but now I finally found a new group of people and im happy. For the teachers at stage coach Dance teacher was amazing and really kind and nice encouraging people instead of favouritism but for dance and acting I wish I could say the same it just felt like pure favouritism and not giving other students or me a chance.

title: Disappointed with lack of UV light for a package advertised ‘Full UV/Neon Disco’
review: EDIT: Company reply promised to get in touch with entertainer and then get in touch with me 3 days ago - I haven’t heard anything.We bought the neon glow disco package. Therefore we went all out on making sure as much of the party decor as possible (decorations, balloons, table cloths etc) were fluorescent colours. We even bought a UV torch to check as we were buying things for the party that they were going to glow up bright. The invitation encouraged guests to wear neon or white and promised a cool glow party. When I spoke to the entertainer a few days before the party (I didn’t catch her name) I mentioned this and was given reassurance that the UV lights she had would fully light the hall and make everything glow. Unfortunately she only came along with 2 small UV lights which sat at either end of the stage behind her. This meant anything near to her did glow up, but anything from about 2 meters away from her was not affected by the black light. I was disappointed as the neon face paints and body crayons I bought to use were useless and most of the decorations didn’t glow up brightly. The entertainer was very good, I can’t fault her skills and she kept the kids entertained well. However she did turn up a little later than discussed as she had gone to my home address rather than the address I gave for the party. This meant that guests started arriving before the music had started so the walked into a silent hall which wasn’t the wow factor I was hoping for. All in all I was disappointed, but had no intention of complaining on the day or withholding payment as the T&C’s state you must if you’re dissatisfied as she was a nice lady, and to be honest after hours of setting up and running a party of very excitable children, the last thing you want is a negative confrontation. I wouldn’t use this company again and don’t think the package should be described as ‘Full UV/Neon Disco’ - perhaps just a ‘disco with various lights’.

title: Late show, chaotic/trashed club and now not replying to my emails.
review: I have previously seen the Dreamboys and had a great night! Unfortunately the show I attended a few weeks ago was utter shambles. This was partly due to being on the same night as the euros which I wasn’t aware when I made the booking. Club was trashed upon arrival, beer everywhere due to them showing the euros prior. Show started late, no drink upon arrival, took ages to be served, no allocated seats even though I had booked tickets that suggested priority seating. Other hens arguing we were in their seats. Lots of other parties filming throughout even when told to stop. No one asked to see our tickets throughout the whole night. Due to show starting late I had to pay additional parking fee as show went over by 1.5 hours. I have since emailed DreamBoys HQ expressing my concerns. Had one reply offering complimentary tickets which I said wasn’t possible due to unable to attend within the next 6 months. Replied asking what my ticket actually entailed as we paid the additional £10 each for better seating etc and I have had no reply. Emailed again, told I would get a response from management within 1-2 days. It has been over a week and no reply. Real shame. Would not attend again, happy to take money and not offer the night described.

title: Really not good
review: Really not good. Brighton show. We attended for a significant event for a friend of mine and purchased a stage pass which expressly states on their website guarantees appearance on stage. My friend was aware of the pass and so we waited in anticipation throughout the (pretty dull) show and... nothing. It has taken more than a week and Dreamboys have finally refunded the stage pass but won't refund out ticket price. Had it not been for their guarantee we would have attended a different show. I would absolutely not recommend this for hen dos. Also I should mention the visibility was appalling. The strippers, who appeared for probably less than 30 mins of the '2 hour' show (the rest of the show being a few songs and jokes from the MC and listening to very loud pop - actually probably the best part of it!) were virtually impossible for us to see from where we were seated. The MC was good though so 2 stars rather than 1! Absolutely not worth the money though.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Them funky feathered friends did well!
review: Really happy with the two personalised calendars I ordered from Funky Pigeon. They are fab. Good quality, great service. Ordered and received super quick, within approx 36 hour! Who said carrier pigeon was a slow service... :-) I would have liked a couple of A4 envelopes as these calendars are gifts, I didn't see an option when ordering. However, I could have missed It. Can't take that away from the service and quality of the produced.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: So easy to do.
review: Im not exactly computer savvy but this was so easy to do. I was able to make a personalised card for my granddaughter and it was beautiful. Took 2 days to reach me in Northern Ireland which I was very impressed with too. The card quality was great, everything was perfect and exactly what I wanted. I would definitely recommend Funky Pigeon for cards and gifts and will be back for more.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Got my xmas cards okay
review: Got my xmas cards okay, there getting more expensive recently though, but at least i saved money from buying on the highstreet as the costs have shot up.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: I will not use again while using Royal Mail
review: I love ordering my special birthday cards etc through Funky pigeon, but unfortunately this will be the last order I do on any site that uses Royal Mail. The cost of the stamps and service is appalling and what they did to the post master is unforgivable. Let me know when you start using another postal service Thank you

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Discounts
review: I was pleasantly relieved to receive the discount which had not gone through on my order for my son’s birthday card. I had to write to the Customer Support though immediately after making my order, which was disconcerting that this had happened. Fortunately I was reimbursed, but I hope this won’t happen again. Having said that, my son appreciated his birthday card 🙂

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Alls well that ends well!
review: Flexible design options.  Card arrived in Hungary on time.  Unfortunately it was too big to fit in the letterbox so it went back to the post office!  I got sent the information but in Hungarian aside my son on the actual day.  Fortunately my son was able to go there on the day to collect the card!

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Good experience, estimated delivery not always accurate
review: I have recently bought several cards with funky pigeon and all have arrived just as I designed. I find that you are a bit limited to having to use the provided templates and it would be good if you could completely design your own card. I was really happy the first time, the card arrived early which was great! However the second time the card arrived 2 days late which was a shame, particularly when I was sent an email saying it would arrive on time. This may have been an unlucky experience and due to the delivery company. Hopefully this won't happen again!

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Arrived later than expected
review: Great selection of cards to choose from. Easy to use website and great card quality. The card did arrive 2 days later than expected, meaning it was a belated birthday card. Give an extra couple of days for slow mail delivery in future. Never had a card arrive late before

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Poor service  Order did not arrive
review: Order did not arrive, still waiting for Funky Pigeon to get back to after sending email 4 days ago.Update   Funky Pigeon contacted myself and apologised for the non delivery and length of time to reply. Refund given.  Review updated  thank you

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Cards did not turn up for my sister in…
review: Cards did not turn up for my sister in laws birthday. 1 week later still no cards.Update / it appears the fault was with Royal Mail. Funky P apologised, offered additional cards which I rejected but they gave me a full refund. I will therefore upgrade my review to a 4 as customer service was excellent.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Good quality cards
review: Good quality cards, endlessly customisable but not always that easy to do though could be just me! Fast delivery but it isn't cheap. Saves going card shopping!

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Fab personalised cards/gifts
review: Funky Pigeon is great for personalised cards or gifts. I've used them for many years now. Never had any major issues but sometimes if you're not home, the orders will be delivered to a neighbour but you won't be informed at all. Took me 3 days to find out where my grandson's card and gift was this year, downstairs with a neighbour, Funky Pigeon couldn't tell me where it was. The delivery guys should inform us somehow imo...a note through my door telling me where to look would be helpful or update the website with a location. Otherwise it would be 5 stars all the way

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: As a whole funky pigeon is perfect
review: Overall, Funky Pigeon is a great way to create cards for all occasions. I like using it to upload and put my own images on cards, and I find the process straightforward and it’s very user-friendly. The layout is simple and understandable. That said, there are moments when the website's menu can be a bit confusing, but it's a minor issue in an otherwise smooth experience.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Using funky pigeon is handy as we live…
review: Using funky pigeon is handy as we live abroad is handy. However the new website is confusing as you don't do the postage until the end instead of for each one as you make it.  Could do with some new cards as I find I am starting to send the same ones each year

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Great
review: Card was great and customer service to put problem right. Ordered 30 September for delivery 3 October. Didn’t arrive till 7 October. No good then as birthday had gone. Royal Mail in my opinion are letting the company down as the card was dispatched on 1 October. Bit of a faff having to email to customer service, however they were great

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Almost full stars!
review: Sadly there was a white mark in the middle of the picture on all 4 postcards which, to us the senders and receivers spoilt it somewhat, but they still enjoyed the fact we'd sent a postcard. However, normally Funky Pigeon are spot on with quality, service and delivery, so we can give you a bye on this occasion! 😘

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Great product & service
review: I ordered a customised cushion for an old friend. The quality of the prints on the cushion was really good considering some of the photographs used were 40+ years old and I was really pleased with the results.  The only issue I had was there wasn't enough padding in the cushion and I had to go out and buy an additional pad for the cushion to plump it up. Service was quick and website easy to use.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Great products, unfortunately expensive postage
review: I used to use Funky Pigeon religiously but because they’ve continued to use Royal Mail and charge postage on cards and gifts separately it’s become too expensive to use now. The quality of the cards and gifts is great but one card and one gift cost me nearly £8 in postage. Shocking and such a shame.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Ordered birthday card 5 days before the…
review: Ordered birthday card 5 days before the birthday, card turn up 3 days late!!Update to review- Have subsequently been contacted by FP customer services who have refunded the cost of card.. at least that is something positive👍

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Great cards
review: I use Funky pigeon quite frequently and have always found their cards good quality. The website and app are easy to navigate, add photos  and personalise. What I found expensive was £3.99 for delivery. The cost of 1 card was over £7! This has never happened before and was shocked. I tried to cancel immediately when I realised, but they have a no option to cancel policy. This is the reason I gave 4*

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Took 6 days to arrive but PO problem?
review: The card took 6 days to arrive but it showed as being posted form FP after 2 days so I guess problem was with Post Office. The card itself was great, as shown on website and in perfect condition.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Great service
review: Great service and card delivered on time. Easy to personalise the card. I found the amount to pay at the checkout a bit confusing because I’d applied a discount and I didn’t find it clear as to what I’d have to pay. Other than that ut was very straightforward.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Quality Drop
review: So I’ve been using Funky Pigeon the last few years now and I was happy with the product previously. But this year has been different for a few reasons…Quality- the paper has significantly dropped in quality from previous year. From the second I picked it up I noticed. Thinner sheets of paper in stead of the more card like material from previous years. Print quality in the photo sections has decreased as well unfortunately. Although I will note that the fidelity of the text has improved. Price- like everything else has so not much to say. Although I will say £5.80 for delivery is extortionate!Delivery- So like I’ve said previously £5.80! Just for some paper! Ridiculous pricing! Granted you can select any day for no extra charge, including next day delivery. Well that’s if yours comes next day! Because mine did not…or the next day…or the day after that! Overall I’d say the service is just okay. It use to be easy to recommend but with all the changes and no mention of them being made it leaves a poor taste in the mouth. Especially when you spend £30 on calendars… I’ll be looking elsewhere at the end of the year I think. Just disappointed and not happy with what I’ve received.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: How corporate greed erodes a company.
review: Funky Pigeon was my go to site for cards but I am having to consider going elsewhere. What was once a great service and great products has become an excersize in corporate graft. Prices have gone up, services such as a free email version of the card have disappeared, discounts are often touted via email only to be bogus or no more than the customary discounts for bulk purchase. offers of free cards are often no more than a trick to get you to log onto the site and if it does pan out, it is so limited and the postal charges so exhorbitant that the offer is all but useless. Worst of all though is the customer service, which was once exemplary and is now none existant.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Badly sized socks
review: Adding photo for the personalised socks was easy. Sadly the size of the socks are bad. My husband is a size a 11 shoe and the socks barely go over his foot let alone his heel. So disappointed, waste of money. Bought as Christmas gift, so didn't know the sizing was this bad.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Paid 2.65 for 1st class
review: Paid 2.65 for 1st class, confirmed dispatch at 12.27 on Thursday and still no sign on Saturday - it says 1-3 days but really not acceptable given paying over the odds, also I would have sent it Wednesday but the system was sticking and taking so long I gave up - I love the personalised cards but ordering is not what it used to be. Birthday will have well passed so now a waste of money !

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Photo block
review: I bought a photo block but most of the glitter is stuck in certain places and cover some photos and also stuck near the bottom even after I try turning the block to move the glitter particles.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Head chopped off
review: I order what I thought was a Xmas bauble with 3 photos of the wife's old dogs printed on the bauble. I received a clear plastic bauble with a paper printed disc inside. The most disappointing thing was one of the dogs had had its head cropped out. Very poor quality product at nearly £15.Maybe I should have looked more closely at what they offer. After contacting me they have redone the bauble and it's now correct.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Slightly concerning
review: Slightly concerning, I was sent my family photo calendar. However I also received someone else’s as well. Whilst I’m very happy with mine I find the mistake quite concerning as I wouldn’t be impressed if mine was sent to the wrong person. I only write this review as I’ve still not had a response regarding this

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Guess you have to fold your own cards now…
review: Have always loved funky pigeon and much preferred to other major rival card company, however, I’ve just received my latest order and none of the cards are folded and no instruction of how to do it myself without damaging the cards. Also one of the cards feels so thin, doesn’t have a gloss finish and generally feels like crap quality. It’s apparently finest premium card. Very disappointed. You want me to fold the cards because you want to reduce cost? No thank you.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: No envelopes
review: Ordered 3 cards, 2 birthday and 1 Christmas, to be delivered to my address. Firstly thought paying a delivery charge for each card was unfair when they could've been posted together and secondly no envelopes provided. Because I was giving them personally I need envelopes as I had to open each card as I had no idea which card was for who. Because of these reasons I don't think I will be using this company again but will go back to the company who don't charge delivery for every card being sent to the same address and who provide envelopes as I can't give cards to people with no envelope.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Great service but rubbish…
review: Great service but rubbish communication. Sent an email on Monday 18th November and have heard nothing since. Funky Pigeon may have their Customer Happiness Team but I’m a Frustrated Customer.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Value for money? I send cards from abroad and l do not…
review: I send cards from abroad and l do not understand why for what l consider a 'normal' price the card is so small. I am now considering going back to buying a card and sending it myself, l just feel as someone who uses Funky Pigeon on a monthly basis l am not getting g a value for money card anymore....sorry but thats how l feel.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Good quality product, a little difficult to do on a mobile.…
review: I love the idea of sending cards & gifts home. It is usually easy to do this so I wanted to give Funky Pigeon a try instead of my usual supplier. The produces arrived when I asked (a date which was a few weeks away). The quality was good.The only downside was I found it difficult to navigate making the personalised card on my mobile.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Card was good, delivery poor
review: Card was good, chocolate was nice, paid an already high price without the delivery charge added onto at the end .which was the disappointment text to say between 9 &10 then another to say 11 till 1pm and it finally arrived at 7pm sorry but the day and event was over sorry £28 for a card and a bar of chocolate should be hand delivered in the morning thanks Adrian

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Not impressed with the changes
review: I used the website for the first time in a while and there appear to have been some functional changes made which I'm not impressed with at all, particularly on personalisation of cards.  There are fewer options, eg font choices and text colours.  My favourite font has gone.  I will probably use own of the other online card providers in future.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Lovely cards.
review: Cards are always great. Good choice, good quality. However, they are often spoiled by the post office who can't seem to see, or read the DO NOT BEND message. I've contacted the Customer Happiness team 2 or 3 days ago but I'm yet to hear back from them.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Nice cards
review: Nice cards. Had a bit trouble selected 4 cards did insides etc but then I couldn't select different destinations for them so had to start again doing them one by one - never used to have to do that so don't much like the new system.Thanks for reply.  I did try to put separate addresses after but it wouldn't let me.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: No envelope
review: Having spent quite a bit of money on a personalised birthday card, I was disappointed to find that it didnt come with an envelope. How am I supposed to give a card to someone with only to mailed packaging to cover it?Shame, because the card was good & delivery prompt.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Mixed experience
review: I know I should have checked beforehand but I was gutted to discover that I could not cancel within minutes, of a card that had been addressed wrongly.  Not just because of the added expense of doing it again, but also because the first, wrongly addressed card, was now useless.Then the 2nd card took almost a week longer than estimated to arrive in Spain, so not a wonderful experience!However, the card was easy to make ready for despatch and the 15-year-old recipient was over the moon with it, even though it was late.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Atari Flashback 9 console disappointment
review: Purchased the Atari Flashback 9 Console, so not really a comment on the service by Funky Pigeon, which was good, but on the Atari system.Contols pretty unresponsive and its not a 'out of the box' start unless you already have a spare HDMI cable.So plenty of games but difficult to navigate.Delivery from Funky Pigeon was ok.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Still waiting for card to be delivered
review: Still waiting for card to be delivered, ordered 30 sept, why pay for postage if delivery takes this longCard finally arrived, postman fault,not funky pigeon,not good not having post for 4days, shortage of postman

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Poor Delivery Experience
review: Quality of the card is good like the last time I ordered, but this time I ordered a Christmas Card for my girlfriend a day and a half before the “Guaranteed Christmas Delivery” period that was advertised on the website and I just received my card today (2nd of January). Very disappointing!

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Not impressed with recent order
review: Not impressed with recent order. Ordered a gift to be sent to a friend. Despite Funky Pigeon stating during order process that it would include name of sender, my friend had no idea who sent the gift!!!

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Half of my order came on time and great…
review: Half of my order came on time and great quality, the other half haven’t even been processed yet. I think they might prioritise tracked deliveries as all of them have been sent. Also despite all going to the same address had to pay separate postage for all of them. The ones that were first class have not even been sent yet. Not going to be here for Christmas very disappointed

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Good Product, poor delivery
review: The scheduled delivery date was not met. I placed an order for two items in October and scheduled the delivery for December, which provided ample time for the items to arrive. However, only one item has been delivered. I am uncertain whether the items are separate deliveries (which should not be the case since they are being sent to the same address). I am disappointed with this outcome.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Over charging
review: Any One have an email address  ?you are asking me to email but difficult to contact anyone .You have asked me to contact you but no contact details on message. Would appreciate contact to you.Over charging . Chocolate were £8.99 it came to nearly £17

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Had a faulty gift
review: Had a faulty gift , gave ref number but would not deal with me , very disappointed it was faulty!!!!

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: LATE at arriving
review: Cards arrive late even though you pay first class postage and then to top this off, customer services are lets say not very good after sending two emails without reply.The cards did eventually turn up exactly one week after purchase so bear this in mind when ordering.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: 30 minutes of my life I'll never get…
review: 30 minutes of my life I'll never get back!Attempted to order personalised mugs. Took ages to upload 3 photos on the first mug (I've got 750mb upload speed btw) Got half way through uploading the photos then the web site just hung, showing a message regarding face recognition?Tried several times again then gave up.Pity because I had a total of 4 mugs that I wanted to order.Now ordered from Moonpig.

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Number balloon
review: Ordered large number helium balloon for a birthday. Within 24 hours it had already significantly deflated. Have had significantly longer lasting ones from other companies so won’t be using Funky Pigeon again for this

description: Personalised cards & gifts for birthday, anniversary, wedding, mothers day, fathers day, valentines day & all occasions. Next day delivery available
title: Smashed Mug
review: Received two mugs packed in separate boxes. Really poor boxes and even poorer packaging: like a flimsy bit of 5" x 5" brown, thin paper, wrapped around the mug handle.Needless to say, one mug handle was smashed on arrival, despite fragile note on front of package.Have informed funky pigeons 'Happiness Team' who deal with complaints. Automated reply saying, "well look into it and basically don't email again as it'll put your question to the back of the queue" So, now I wait. They want the money but their customer service is terrible. Shame we can pay after quality checking the item! I note another mug arrived to another customer er smashed, a few days ago. Please sort your packaging out FP!
