review: Easy to use site. Would be better if the date and time for VIP selections showed on the items in the cart. It would have been nice to know that there was going to be an additional fee associated with my credit card from booking through the site since it is international for some users.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Booking the tickets was quite straight…
review: Booking the tickets was quite straight forwards. I’m happy with the ticket price as it is a bit cheaper then going through the companies direct. There is info available on the site if you look for it on how to add the tickets to apps etc. I was told at the end that you can get a £10 referral voucher if a friend uses your name to order. When another member of our group then went to order their tickets and do that, there was no space to add the referral name so we lost out on that offer. It’s good that they offer the option for insurance if you need to cancel and that’s all you have to pay until closer to the time you travel. Only problem then is that they don’t give you the tickets until it’s fully paid for, so I can’t link them to my app yet. I understand why they do that, just a shame and will have someone like me who wants to get it all ready, handing over nearly £3k months before I have to.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Issue sorted quickly - hopefully
review: UPDATE: It looked like the pending amount for the 1st order that was an unsuccessful didn’t drop off and was taken from my card. Another phone call to resolve and it appears there were 8 attempts at payment and 7 inactive orders. Unfortunately one of the orders stated not active but had taken payment. Now waiting for the refund to be applied. Well and truly got hit by IT and ordering gremlins._____________Had an issue online where the system ordered double the number of tickets and created a 2nd order.One phone call and it was sorted very quickly. E-tickets came through within an hour and ready to upload to the Disney app.Highly recommend AT.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: My go to for Orlando tickets.
review: Having used AT before, I find them easy to deal with, and their knowledge and guidance is invaluable when trying to decide which ticket options would suit our needs. My only gripe is that we reserved our tickets 7 months ago, only to find a recent promotion offered them at a cheaper price. Although, we did get them at the promotional price, we had to forfeit our original deposit, thus not saving as much as I had hoped for. In the scheme of things, the loss of £60 is small fry against our £6K+ purchase. But considering, they’re not required for nearly 4 months, I’d hoped for a little flexibility regarding our initial deposit. That said, it hasn’t deterred me from using AT in the future.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Good service
review: I had booked Disney & Universal combo tickets with a black friday offer. In Feb we booked our flights to depart 2 days earlier than planned. I called the other day to ask how universal tickets worked. I explained the situation about the disney element and upon checking there was a better deal now saving approx 300 on out original offer so she transferred the deposit paid to another booking ensuring the disney tickets start on the day we want and cancelled the original. We got confirmation minutes later. The person who sorted it was called Kim.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Highly recommend
review: I've been buying tickets from Attraction Tickets for over 10 years now and they've always been helpful and very knowledgeable, guiding me as to what tickets best suited our family's needs. I'd highly recommend their Orlando Freedom ticket. Their website is easy to use but when I've had to speak to a rep to clarify something I got through really quickly and my query was resolved with ease. I'll be back again next year for more tickets.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Still waiting on customer service...
review: I did not find ordering tickets too difficult, however my credit card didn't go through the first attempt and when I successfully got it to work the 2nd time, the system defaulted my name of one of the tickets that should have had someone else's name. I have reached out to customer service and after 24 hours I still do not have assistance to correct the error.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: The free photos aren't disney photos
review: The free photos aren't disney photos they are photos you take on your phone and then upload. This was very confusing until we re-read the description. Apart from that the pass were sent to my email quickly and uploaded to my disney app already to go

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Easy sale, poor after-sales experience
review: Tickets arrived fine, no problems. However, the express pass was only for one park (we had a two park pass and this wasn’t made clear). Also, Universal closed at 5pm due to Halloween so we lost a third of our day (also not made clear). Tried the email contact on US website, that got bounced. Made various other attempts to other generic addresses and finally got an acknowledgement but haven’t had a response 5 days later. In summary, easy to buy but poor after sales.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: They keep badgering me for reviews
review: They keep badgering me for reviews. There's not much to say when you've spent hundreds on tickets and don't have access to them yet. I can't give a 5 star review because I don't have what I paid for yet, I can't give a 1 star review because I might not get access to the tickets until 30 days before I travel and that's still 8months away. Please stop asking for reviews about this fraught process. I ticked boxes, paid my money, the site crashed on my first attempt but I persevered, now I am in limbo waiting to see if I get what I paid for. I'm sure I will, once that happens I can give an honest opinion. Maybe change your algorithm to only pester the people who have received and used what they have paid for?

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: It was difficult to link the New York…
review: It was difficult to link the New York go city tickets to the go city app.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: CHEATED with the price
review: Easy process to book and order tickets However the company sales aren’t that good anymore tickets were cheaper the week before Black Friday with no discount code. I feel a little bit cheated

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Waiting to be processed.
review: I have used attraction tickets a few times and have always found it easy and speedy in getting tickets for upcoming holidays however this review is based on most recent experience and I am feeling anxious my tickets have been in “Processing” for approx. 2 weeks. Normally this process is a few days maximum when I can access digital tickets. I hope everything is ok and I get confirmation soon I can download them.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Felt more like a money making concern than a fireworks display
review: The waiting time for the bar and food stalls were unbelievably long, and the choice at the bar was terrible, and the staff were very rude. The car park exit was unbelievably slow, as the staff were not there to assist the exit, not like when we arrived. The fireworks were really good 👍

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Purchased 14 Day Magic Tickets
review: Purchased 14 Day magic tickets - this gave us access to all 4 Disney theme parks however, 1.'Dine 4 Less' & 'Dollar off Drinks' were refused by food outlets and could not be redeemed! 2. Blizzard water park was part of the package deal (we selected this to suit our young family) but closed for business! Really disappointed - park staff told us we had been scammed and should request a partial refund.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Needed driving licence to release…
review: Needed driving licence to release tickets at space Kennedy centre . Didn’t have it in me . At Gatorland wouldn’t accept screen shot of tickets had to log in to e mail then into attrition ticket s took too long

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Easy to purchase which was great
review: Easy to purchase which was great . Unable to add tickets to wallet on phone - tickets downloaded as pdf which meant they had to be enlarged each time for scanning - we had to do this for 5 people. Fine but a little inconvenient. Also for one of our tickets the name was incorrect as it was not an English name  Éamonn - this appeared as characters Ã‰amonn . Embarrassing at entry point and obviously not matching the name in ID .

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Shrek staff told us we May not get onto…
review: Shrek staff told us we May not get onto attractions as hadn't booked times slot. I advised staff when booked 5 in 1 pass I was only to book tickets at madame tussard.  Was sent to ticket staff in glass bow area who said I was unable to book time slots for other attractions. This cross communication added stress worrying I may not be able to use tickets and wasted time on my holiday.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Good Black Friday offer but still disappointed
review: I’ve purchased from Attraction tickets every time I book Disney trips so will always recommend. Good Black Friday offer for Florida and California tickets. However, looking a week later the Florida tickets were £30 cheaper and I can only put it down, that it didn’t include a “free” magic band. I decided not to complain as I did get a discount with Black Friday but I felt as if I was lied to and rather not had the magic band

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Was it right choice? Unsure
review: Liked choices shown on website and agent was very lovely to chat with ...however confirmation took a while to come particularly universal. I split my reservation between Disney and universal and Disney confirmation came first with part of trip which made us stressed regarding the other half of trip...might have been easier to book elsewhere at this point

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Siam Park
review: The queue system at Siam Park entrance was not clear with at least five huge queues on our arrival. We eventually found the correct queue for pre paid tickets. Overall the park was very busy and queues for many rides were long, the layout of the park is like a maze also and not intuitively laid out, lots of dead ends. Free burger was included in our ticket which was actually ok. Food queues were busy but you got served quite quickly and prices (for additional items) were high but not unexpected

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Disappointed
review: I booked by phonecall disney hotel & park tickets on the 18th April. All went really well & was pleased with booking service but until I noticed my daughters name was spelt wrong on the booking even though I spelled out my daughters name to the lady. Now trying to get this corrected is a nightmare! I have phoned, emailed, Whatsapp but still no one has corrected it. They have acknowledged  & put a request down to get this corrected but why is no one correcting it?

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: I booked my tickets and instantly had…
review: I booked my tickets and instantly had an email saying payment failed even though the money had left the bank! After a quick phone call the lovely lady on the phone resolved the issue I had faced in minutes and I received my tickets via email with in 5 minutes of ending the call.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Payment problem
review: I had a problem with paying for my tickets. Went through payment screen and I then had a message stating payment was pending and would be confirmed within 24 hours. This didn't happen and we were worried that our money was being scammed. 2 days later, I did receive a call from Ticket office and matter was resolved but it was very worrying.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Great info, shame about the payment system.
review: Great information on all the tickets etc, but when it comes to payment, the website kept doubling the basket, and then the payment failed for no reason twice. On the third attempt we made it past the payment page only to be greeted by a blank web page, no confirmation of whether the payment was successful or not.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Tough to book two hotels in one go
review: It was incredibly hard to book two separate hotels at the same time as the system would default to whatever I had been looking at and then void any discount codes. Eventually I had to book them as two separate stays for the same two week period we were there for. In itself not a problem but I will have to check the two bookings separately in order to make sure nothing is missed. Might be something to address from your side?

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: No Tickets yet
review: We paid, but after a 4 days still no tickets. Hopefully will they arrive in time, our holiday will start in a few days.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Not the greatest due to refitbishments
review: Bought disneyland Paris tickets for the weekend. Half of the place was closed for refurbishment and half of the attractions were closed this was a disgrace as we were not informed of this at the time of booking that I can remember and it's not great paying that amount to see alot of places under refurbishment or closed They replied. After taking full price for alot of attractions being closed with 'hope you still managed to enjoy the trip'Surly discounted tickets should be sold if almost 1/4 of the attractions etc were closed for refurbishment, but NO again everyone just takes the cash and does not care about the actual experience.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Tried to charge me for the same tickets…
review: Tried to charge me for the same tickets twice, bank tried to block my card for fraud causing much hassle. Types of tickets listed are incredibly convoluted, and very hard to understand. Until I applied a Black Friday discount tickets listed were £200 more than buying direct from Universal which is very suspect because Universal sell their tickets from their website VIA AttractionTickets. Also hate that I am forced to buy 14 days of tickets when I will only be using 2.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Nowhere on the website does it say that…
review: Nowhere on the website does it say that there will be a delay issuing tickets. At best it’s misleading, at worst, it false advertising. It says on the website that upon payment in full, our Disney tickets would be available to then link to the MDE app. I paid in full, then got a confirmation email saying my order was pending and I would receive the tickets mid-December. Not good. Not acceptable

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Expired tickets for attraction sent
review: Expired tickets for attraction sent.Booked tickets for Kennedy Space Centre and these had expired upon arrival  (previously used tickets). Delayed therefore in getting into attraction.Venue was able to resolve but time lost and had to resolve ourselves. Contacted customer service who sent apology but that was all

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Good customer service but that's it ends.
review: Good customer service, quick and easy but you pay heavily for amendments even though they say its free on their website. Even states that VA charges for amendments when they don't, they only charge for increase in flights. This is for flights for September next year. Not like it's this week. Beware!

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Discovery Cove tickets
review: I bought discovery cove tickets on November 7th and it says you will have them in 48hrs. They took the money straightaway but it’s now November 16th and I still don’t have the tickets

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: There was no mention on the account…
review: There was no mention on the account registration that the payment and account emails had to be the same. I had to phone after two days to query non receipt. I was then told that an email had been sent to me explaining the issue, no email was received. The email did however miraculously appear after I mentioned this on the phone.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: No physical tickets or magic bands
review: This is very disappointing to hear. It's always nice to have physical tickets or cards as a souvenir or keepsake from your trip. Having to go out of your way to pick up a magic band or rely on a barcode for entry can definitely take away from the excitement of visiting these parks. Hopefully, in the future, they can find a better solution for providing tickets to their customers.

description: We offer Disney tickets, Universal Orlando Resort™ tickets and a range of other attractions at unbeatable prices. Get your attraction tickets today
title: Couldn’t get free burgers as they ran…
review: Couldn’t get free burgers as they ran out and had already scanned them on my phone and wouldn’t give us any option of a alternative and was very unhelpful

review: Firstly I'd like to say the children were all absolute stars in their performance. However, this is a review of the actual company.I am deeply disappointed. I saw no confidence growth or direction in the term or final performance, in comparison to other performances with other places. There were no props, costumes, or theatre back drops. There was nothing theatrical about it. For the costs, and their advertisements I'd expected more than the singing and dancing the kids do at home in their bedroom. £243 fee for the term, followed by costs of theatre train t-shirt, I never did purchase dance shoes on top. It was then a £30 charge to watch my own child perform, this was not included. Then further ticket charges. Overall I spent over £300. It wasn't the professional experience I expected. The amount they're are making is incredible, but I struggle to see any of that put into the final performance. Will find another theatre group.

title: Charlatans
review: We advised them that we were running late to 'The London Tombs Ghost Hunts' event of which this information was apparently passed onto the team on site. We could not attend the event as the number provided wasn't even for a team member at the event and it's crystal clear this information wasn't passed on. I emailed to complain, requesting a refund and got a rather blunt email referencing their terms and conditions. Appalling, the only word that comes to mind is charlatans.UPDATE:In an email following the original review the organiser said we should of approached the doorman at the club next to the venue, however, how were we supposed to know that they would have been able to assit and why didn't the individual I spoke to on the phone tell me that. They then go onto state that an individual from the team attending the event went outside at 12.30, if that was indeed the case then surely they would have seen us and why didn't they ring back to say any of that. They then mention threatening emails and phonecalls, the emails are not of a threatening nature in any way, shape or form, and in terms of phonecalls, we weren't able to speak to anyone or leave a message to be threatening in any way. I spoke to one individual verbally and that was it to inform them that we were running late and left a message to that effect. I referenced in the email that I would be using an alternative company which is more than understandable. Apparently admission to a following date would have been offered which I find highly unlikely.

title: Bron y Garth Friday 13th…
review: We attended Bron y Garth on Friday 13th sept. We have done lots of these nights and have to say we were really disappointed with the evening. There was very very little equipment. One ouija board between 12, no table tipping, glass work, scrying etc the ‘tech’ half of the evening involved one member sitting for 30 minutes in his own with headphones on whilst being ignored, a couple of cat balls and an Alice box which was ignored after the first five minutes.  There was little respect for the spirits on the ouija board which made us feel esp uncomfortable when ‘Chell’ the host was encouraging guests to tell the spirits to go away and refuse to engage with them, esp when she referred to them as ‘a-holes’ at one point just because they appeared to be playing with us. There were a couple of reasons this might have been. Given the history of the building they could have been Welsh speakers and not fully understood what we were asking or they could have been children who didn’t know how to spell etc our could have just been having some fun and being cheeky, nothing suggested evil spirits or anything sinister, but they were told not to bother us and that we didn’t want to speak to them because the group couldn’t get the answers they wanted!Frank spent our group time talking to us rather than encouraging the spirits or trying to get guests involved. We as a group, had encouraged others throughout the evening to join in and have a go but, had this point given up, as the hosts seemed totally flat and uninterested. One person actually fell asleep and one half of our group was completely ignored in another room. We were lucky we have had far more positive evenings with other companies as , had this been our first investigation it may well have been our last. We travelled 4 hours for a very disappointing evening.

title: True Crime Museum Hastings
review: Our event was run by 2 ladies. There was plenty of equipment but neither of the ladies seemed to be able to interpret the results correctly.For example, there were several infra red cameras which had been placed where ‘they couldnt pick us up’ and one of them always went off everytime someone walked past. It obviously had a wide angle lens so we turned it round when no one was looking and it hardly went off at all after that.I don’t think it was deliberate, they just seemed very inexperienced.Won’t be going again.Follow up following comment from provider -  we were told a couple of times that we would be split into 2 groups. We never were. We were told we would be doing a human pendulum twice. We never did. We can't keep asking. We were never shown what equipment was available. The SLS meter stick men were identifed as spirits but it looked like the device was just picking up the framework of the objects.  No structure to the evening. We were just left to wander around the rooms. Two very long tea breaks. Oh and the first impression of being ticked off on a list on a handwritten scrap of paper was totally unprofessional. To be fair, it was good hearing footsteps in the area outside the room at the end was interesting. And we understand that there was a good result on the oiuja board. Overall it was a quiet night spirit wise and this will, of course, happen sometimes but we did feel that a lot of the time, too much was being read into things.

title: The old ones are the best
review: The old ones are the best. They say that about jokes but it applies equally to plays like Dear Octopus, Dodie Smith’s four-generational just-before-World War II upper-middle-class family saga written in 1938, at the lovely Lyttelton Theatre on London’s South Bank. Old-fashioned and dated it may be but it has drama, romance, much humour and even more truth. An immaculate cast headed by the divine Lindsay Duncan give their all. Some words occasionally hard to catch, especially by the children, but the ones we could hear were well worth hearing. They were filming it on Wednesday for National Theatre At Home in front of an enthusiastic full house. It was a privilege to be a part of it and from great seats too although it’s such a well-designed theatre you’d get a good view from anywhere.

We offer FREE tickets to shows or events covering a wide variety of genres, from theatre to stand-up comedy; dance to cabaret and burlesque; classical music to modern concerts; family shows to talks and guided walks; LGBTQIA+ and more.  There is something for everyone at The Audience Club.

Our mission is to offer you lots of FREE shows all over London and your challenge is to fill the seats!

We partner with amazing producers and event organisers looking to ensure a full audience for special events, press nights or simply quieter performances.  In return, our members are asked to be discreet about their free tickets and to provide feedback for the show or experience they attended.

Hundreds of shows or events are available for our members for free.  Join today and pay just £5 for 12 months of access and forget about paying for a full-price ticket again!

The Audience Club is passionate about supporting the Arts industry and has donated more than £270,000 to charities and counting!  From supporting drama and music students to donating towards production costs and purchasing new stage equipment, we are playing our part in ensuring the show will go on!

Love The ArtsLove Free Tickets
title: Making new discoveries
review: The Audience Club is a great way to discover a range of genres, new talent, and even quirky venues that you probably would never come across otherwise. The variety of shows and activities on offer is generally good although that seems to be changing and less so now with the basic membership. But all this with the great benefit of low prices. The Club is doing well at providing a unique service not just for theatre and art lovers, but for the performers and artists too.

title: Audience Club Review 10th August 2023
review: Audience Club provides a diverse selection of plays, films and music. They only charge administrative costs so members are able to see a wide range of productions at very little expense. They email members roughly twice a week to let them know which tickets are available. For popular shows it is advisable to book as soon as possible. They are good at providing a brief synopsis of the play to enable members to have some idea what it is about. They have some tickets available for the same day they send the email. I usually find this too short notice, however they also notify you of productions at a later date. Overall I have found Audience Club invaluable to enable me to be able to access plays etc. which normally I wouldn't be able to afford.

title: Disneyland via Romford
review: On Sunday 24th March, I became a honorary Essex girl as I visited the Brookside Theatre in Romford.  Curtesy of  "THE AUDIENCE CLUB" I attended together with my three sons the afternoon matinee show, and listened to the delights of "The Magic of Disney".  This was pure nostalgia of my once upon a time childhood.  We had nine wonderful singers, one of whom was the most adorable and very brave young female singer. She displayed such confidence and a bright future truly beckons for her as long as she is encouraged with opportunities to continually develop her talent .God help the outcasts - [ The Hunchback of Notre Dame } - was my absolute favourite.  I would really like to hear that with a full band and the choristers of Westminster Abbey.  World Book Day next year would an ideal event to hear {Pinocchio} When you wish upon a star in a West End Theatre. A theatre full of young readers and lovers of costume fashion.Disappointingly, I could not purchase a programme, as none were being sold.  I really do enjoy reading for reference the musical journey of each singer. I did however purchase snacks and drinks.Very well done to you all.  I thoroughly enjoyed myself on my debut outing with the audience club.Elaine

title: The concept is great
review: The concept is great. I have seen many shows (which I may have previously not chosen to see), at a host of venues (which I hadn't heard of), at great prices. To many of these venues I have returned, now I've become aware of them. I have also found the speed of response when something goes awry on the day of a show is excellent and demonstrates customer service that is second to none.Previously the web site was very good, but a recent review has made the web site much worse and unhelpful. It is largely this factor that has me choosing 3 stars instead of 5 stars as my rating.I really don't need to have in prime position a list of my previous shows. These could be looked up at the touch of a button but now are the first thing we see and in grey text on a white background which isn't good textually.I get excellent emails with shows I might like to see, but finding those on the list of shows (Theatre Ladder) has been been made much more difficult because the search facility for both show names and venues has been removed (I don't understand why that has been done). At least the 'map' of locations has been reinstated, which is a great facility which I am glad has been reintroduced.The search on dates is OK. The 'locations' search is not good: Which parts of London or other locations may not be clear to anyone with a particular venue in mind. The old way of searching for a venue by name was very much easier, especially if you know where you are going to be and have a particular venue in mind. I would really love to see these search facilities reinstated. This would make the use of the theatre ladder more customer friendly.

title: Company takes takes offence if you book less than 5 events or with other companys
review: I've been with The Audience Club since 2016 a few years after it started and it was good offering music, cabaret, theatre, comedy and all manner of events. Annual membership was nominal as were the actual event costs and I really liked it's closed membership policy, in that once they reach their chosen quota no more applicants are admitted.The downside is that if you don't book 5 events per year, you are not informed by email when renewal is due, your account is closed and any monies in your "kitty" (you have to add funds before you can book any events) are donated to charity.It does seem strange to notify people who have attended 5+ events per year that renewal is due, but not notify those who've seen less than 5 events and it means that they don't know the account is closed or to withdraw their kitty. I think this is an area to improve upon. This was answered in an unexpected email to me from their Director which was strange and unprofessional and saw me terminating my membership altogether;Sent: Monday, 15 July 2019 17:13Dear NatashaI don’t email people who only book two shows when their  membership  ends,  only  good bookers  as  I am  interested in filling seats and would prefer to have people who show a  commitment.As you are with so many other paperers  I  wonder  if this is a wise move committing yourself  to  attending  5 shows  in year to  TAC,  your priority will be  to the others  as you have  proved over the last 2.5 years and  if you decide over the next week that the shows that we have  are such low quality that you would not  possibly  consider booking them Then do let me know and I will close your account  and refund your  £10.00.It must be the pressure of  belonging to so many other companies that is confusing.Best  regardsAngela Hyde-Courtney -  Director – The Audience Club Ltd***********I had already written a 4* review but having received the above, for reasons still unknown, I can't justifiably recommend it any longer. This company is small so takes you booking with other company or not booking more than 5 events, very personally, as you can see for yourself.

title: Perfect children’s entertainment
review: Snow princesses were so professional, they always responded quickly to my emails and answered any questions I had. Their costume's are good quality which helps provide a great experience for the kids. The entertainment was a mixture of games and experiences which the children loved!! At one point the birthday girl became overwhelmed and walked away, Heather was amazing and found time to go over to her and check she was okay and help her to continue joining in.Thank you so much 😊

title: Fantastic 5th birthday party
review: Princess Laura came as Elsa to my 5th daughter’s party and from the moment it started until the end, she was the perfect party host.My daughter has the best time with her friends and cousins as all the games were fun and engaging. Timings of the games, tattoos, food and cake were good. The finale with the snow machine was just wow! Adults and children were all loving it! Would highly recommend them.

title: We had a wonderful time with Princess…
review: We had a wonderful time with Princess Sian coming for our daughter party as Elsa. I was impressed with how she stayed in character from the moment she knocked the door to the moment she left. She clearly knows her stuff and has a wonderful way with the kids. My daughter realised her dream of meeting Elsa but her friends were also starstruck and I know some mums have definitely already taken a business card!

title: Fabulous home visit
review: We had a fabulous home visit from Hampshire-based Princess Elsa, who packed a huge amount into her visit. We were so impressed about the value for money and how 'in character' Elsa was, despite having to juggle a huge amount of props in a house she'd never been to before! Grown ups had tears in their eyes and the children were completely captivated for the duration of her visit. She was so genuine and convincing she completely enthralled them and we wouldn't hesitate to recommend her.

title: We had the lovely Princess Christina as…
review: We had the lovely Princess Christina as Elsa for a birthday party and visit to our shop. It was truly magical every child was completely mesmerised the entertainment was perfect and Christina was so great at getting the kids up and dancing even when shy at the start. We will definitely be using Christina for all our future parties!

title: Magical Princess Party
review: We booked Snow Princess party for our daughter's 4th birthday. Commuication prior to the party was great and informative.Princess Laura was Cinderella for the party. She was amazing. Played lots of games and kept all the kids entertained. They loved the glitter tattoes and gifts. Highlight was the crowning ceremony which my daughter loved.  Princess Laura did a great job and we got lots of positive feedback from other parents. Really appreciate her hard work in prepping for the party with some Cinderella themed games. It was also great parents could join in with all the fun too! Best party ever! My little girl loved feeling so special. Definitely recommend booking Snow Princess if you are looking for a magical, memorable party!

title: Elsa home visit
review: We had Princess Anna come do our Elsa home visit today and truly it was magical! She amazed two very excited little girls, who were so engaged in what she was doing. They loved their glitter tattoes, the story and the singing and to top it off thet reallg enjoyed opening their goody bags. It felt very personal and was a wonderful experience. Highly recommend and will be looking to book for my little girls birthday in the future.

title: Home visit from Queen Elsa
review: Anna visited our home as Queen Elsa for my daughter and her friends and she was absolutely amazing! So professional, so warm and friendly and patient with the girls as they plagued her with excited questions and she stayed in character so wonderfully from start to finish, she was more Elsa than Elsa herself! It was great how much she fit into her visit also; singing, story telling, photographs, a bit of Frozen magic, glitter tattoos for each of the girls. Off of Anna’s visit myself and my friends now want to book again! Thankyou so much Anna!

title: We had the most magical house visit…
review: We had the most magical house visit from Elsa (Princess Kelsey) this evening.  Our daughter Margo was in dreamland!  Elsa was amazing!  She sang and danced with our little girl, told her a lovely story and gave her some wonderful gifts.  So sincere, talented and professional from beginning to end.  We can not thank you enough.  You’ve made our Margo’s Christmas.

title: As always Anna made her visit magical
review: As always Anna made her visit magical! The Christmas doorstop visit was such a fantastic thing.my 6 year old was just gobsmacked that princess elsa came to visit her just before Christmas…thank you so much for the magic and helping make memories.xx

title: Fabulous Frozen Party
review: We had princess Megan (Anna) and princess Laura (Elsa) at our daughter’s 5th Birthday party. Communication in the lead up from Princess Kelsey was brilliant. She was extremely helpful and made everything easy. On the day they were on time, made a fuss of the birthday girl and everyone enjoyed a fantastic party. The snow machine was a great addition which I’m so pleased we added. Really made the party end with a bang. Princess Megan promptly sent me some photos she took on the day which was really good of her (Thank you!). The only thing that took me by surprise was Princess Laura asking my daughter for a spare party bag for Olaf. We actually only had 1 spare but luckily we did as my daughter would have been upset saying no to a bag for Olaf. Maybe it’s me (1st time using an entertainer) but found it a little cheeky. Would definitely use them again in future though as the party was fabulous.

title: Elsa and Anna 4th birthday party
review: My daughter had her 4th birthday party and both Elsa and Anna were amazing, so smiley and friendly. The children all enjoyed the entertainment and loved getting cute little prizes too. Elsa and Anna got the adults involved in 2 games, not too much, the perfect amount! The cake and the crowning ceremony was my favourite, to see my little girls face through the magic they'd created was amazing!! Elsa regularly 'checked in' with myself both of us giving equal direction of the times of the party. It worked so well, I was stress free it was perfect they took care of everything!!!! I do feel that when the children are arriving there could of been a little more interaction to begin with instead of both doing glitter tattoos one could of mingled a little, having said that, there were a few shy children to begin with that ended up joining in. I would 100% recommend Snow Princess to anyone, it's well worth the money!!!

title: Queen Elsa (Amy) and Nelly (Sian) the…
review: Queen Elsa (Amy) and Nelly (Sian) the Pirate were fabulous entertainers for our little girls 3rd birthday party. Not only did they make our daughter feel like an absolute superstar but all of the games were perfectly dedicated to the children's ages. Amy had such a beautiful singing voice too! Thank you.

title: Cinderella was very lovely and…
review: Cinderella was very lovely and entertained the kids really well.We chose this company as they also do magic which my daughter loves, but sadly they didn’t have the right equipment to do it and didn’t charge us- that was just a shame as Olivia would have seen that as the highlight.But overall what a wonderful day we had- only reason not to give 5 stars was that the magic was what made us choose them

title: Mermaid party - great!
review: Great party! The entertainers took care of the children and kept them all engaged with fun and varied games. They even got the parents involved in some aspects which is a good laugh and particularly fun for the children.They arrived early to greet my daughter and also to stay at the end for individual photos. It was all very relaxed.Thank you!

title: Anna was a unicorn for my 4 year olds party
review: Anna was great as a unicorn at my daughters 4th birthday party. She looked the part and kept the children all entertained and held great structure to the party. The only reason I gave her a 4 instead of a 5 is because there were a few games and songs that were more for toddlers that 4 year olds. Like baby shark and hop little bunny, also the big multicoloured blanket game. My daughter was inside telling me how it was for babies. Lastly I was really hoping she would sing but she didn’t. Lots of reviews of her great singing voice but we didn’t hear it. Other than that, she made it a very stress free party for me, the kids had a lovely time and she was very professional, staying in character the whole time.

title: Thank you to Elsa (Kelsey) for making…
review: Thank you to Elsa (Kelsey) for making my daughter's 4th birthday extra special. Kelsey arrived on time and kept all the kids entertained all through.I will definitely recommend Kelsey @SnowPrincess Parties.

title: Cool Kev is the way to go!
review: If you’re looking for someone to make your child’s party absolutely unforgettable, Cool Kev is the one! He hosted my son Zane’s 4th birthday party, and I cannot recommend him enough. From the moment the party started, Kev’s energy was magnetic. He captivated the kids with his fun games, lively activities, and nonstop enthusiasm, keeping every child engaged and entertained the entire time. But what truly set him apart was how he involved the parents too—it wasn’t just a kids’ party; it became a full-on celebration for everyone in the room!Many parents came up to me during and after the party to comment on how fantastic Kev was. He had the adults cheering, laughing, and even participating in some of the activities, which added such a special and unique vibe to the day. It’s rare to find someone who can seamlessly bring kids and parents together in such a fun and effortless way, but Kev did it flawlessly. Everyone left the party talking about how amazing he was.Kev’s ability to connect with the kids was incredible. He made every child feel included, even those who were shy or hesitant at first. He had them giggling, dancing, and jumping for joy, creating memories they’ll cherish forever. Overall, Cool Kev didn’t just host the party—he made the party. If you want an unforgettable experience for your child’s birthday, Cool Kev is the way to go!

title: Farce at Coop live in Hangout
review: Update - so I've now changed this score from a 1 to a 4, why? I managed to contact customer service on their online contact page. They've checked with the venue, it's confirmed our issue and so Seat Unique offered us some free tickets to a choice of a few other events. So, I guess they've hopefully learned from what happened to us and also tried to make amends. So, only right I update my submission and score. ORIGINAL MESSAGE: First of all, how do you actually complain to these people, I can see no process for complaining on their website. Yes, a contact page but no complaints process I can see - so that in a way says beware.I've used these before and bene happy, booking tickets this time was good and easy but them it all changed and it maybe Coop live as much a Seat Unique. We had tickets on 7th to see Sam Fender. When we go there, Hangout VIP, the guy who looks after you at the entrance couldn't even find our seats. All seats had a number but ours didn't as they wee actually almost against the wall, behind where the artist stand - so pretty bad for VIP. So bad our hadn't even been numbered. Frustrated we went for a drink, came back, sat down and the got asked to move, as they'd 'put the curtain at the wrong end', so moved it in front of our seat. Immediately in font of our seats, total blackout, zero view. I asked what we should now do, and they moved us to two booked but empty seats, we were in early to see the support band. Later, when people arrived, we had to move out of those seats and stand up all night, in the VIP section, trying to see between people shoulders. Really bad. So beware, clearly no one from Seat Unique's done their due diligence here!!! Shame as in the past I've been happy with them, seat Unique and like Coop live but this VIP experience was a complete farce.

description:
Who We Are
London Theatre Direct are among the leading providers of theatre tickets in the UK. We were one of the very first websites to sell theatre tickets online and since our company’s founding in 1999, we have sold over 20 million London theatre tickets and counting.

Musicals 

Plays 

Discounts 

Best Sellers 

Vouchers 
What We OfferWe sell tickets for large musicals and plays, immersive theatre events, opera and dance shows. As we work with so many venues and productions, we are able to offer amazing discounts on theatre tickets, exclusive access to tickets and premium packages so you can See It In Style with London Theatre Direct.

We are a fully bonded London theatre ticket agency and distributor, and we work directly with all the major theatre groups in London including Andrew Lloyd Webber's Really Useful Group, Nimax Theatres, Ambassador Theatre Group, Delfont Mackintosh Theatres and many more individual theatres and smaller theatre groups.

title: Sunset Boulevard - good but nothing like the original.
review: Saw Sunset Boulevard at the Savoy Theatre on 2nd November. But after seeing the original about 6 times in the 90s, I was expecting a better show and disappointed at their production. The music and singers were great and Nicole Scherzinger was brilliant, but with no scenery it lost the impact. I know it is only a 16 week run and the scenery would have been expensive but it wasn't for me. I liked the live outside film of Joe Gillis singing Sunset Boulevard, that was the best part for me. If anyone who hadn't seen the original, I think they would find it hard to follow. Well done, but nowhere near the original.

title: Extra star given because the hen had a great time
review: 4 stars because my mum had the best time for her hen. It was a great couple of hours but if I'm being honest there are a couple of areas which let him down.Preston sent me a voice note the day before the event introducing himself and letting us know what we should expect. The event was taking place in a different hotel to where we were staying which I explained when he asked about rooms etc. My mums hen was arranged via a third party so I forwarded Preston a msg from them explaining what he needed to say when arriving at the hotel. Later on that day he sent me another voice note asking if we could move our booking forward by half hour, which was fine and I assumed he had cleared this with the hotel which we later realised he hadn't, didn't really matter though as we were able to go up. The day of our event I woke up to a deleted what's app msg which was sent at midnight, a missed call which he had then sent a text apologising and then another missed call. This all seemed a bit much and tbh made me feel uncomfortable. 9am I receive a message asking if i had a room number yet, which I explained again that I wasn't staying at that hotel so knew as much as him, 9.34am another text asking what time we would be arriving, I literally just replied with the time we had agreed on the afternoon before. I was on my mums hen do and didn't really appreciate the backwards and forwards of texts/voice notes, I wasn't happy my number had been given out tbh. Preston arrived with Wayne, it was Wayne's first event and he was brilliant. A very calming personality and very very easy on the eye. Can I please advise that the 2 following games are removed as they r so boring and not hen do games at all, spoof and the padlock game. We were all given 90 seconds to try and open up a padlock with a key, then an extra 30 seconds each to try with a clue he gave us, then we all had another go once he told is how to do it! This dragged on so much.Things livened up when 'never have I ever' started and when we had to find stickers they had stuck to themselves and we were blindfolded. Also Preston was on his vape so much which again is very unprofessional.

review: I recently visited Winter Wonderland and was quite disappointed. Almost all (if not all) the game stands had prizes provided by a company called Oakes Leisure Limited, and they were truly horrendous. They only had stuffed animals that were poorly made and deformed, with no real care put into their design. It felt as though the organisers were purely focused on profit, cutting corners with cheap, low-quality items that many people will likely throw away, contributing to unnecessary waste.To make matters worse, some of the prizes were oversized stuffed bananas and animals, bigger than a human, which seemed both absurd and wasteful. The food stands only added to the problem by relying entirely on disposable items, creating even more waste.Winter Wonderland should seriously reconsider its approach, offering better, more sustainable prizes and taking responsibility for its environmental impact. It’s time they stopped prioritising profits and started taking climate change seriously, providing experiences that are less harmful to the environment and more respectful to their customers.

I found security pleasant and helpful. But you could just not move it was just ridiculous couldn't get a seat to have a drink and food with the kids. We  stayed in there for 1.5 hours including the circus as queues for any rides where huge. It cost me £111 for the circus and entry for us, and another £100 on candy floss and trying to win a teddy. In comparison if we went to another similar type fair this would have cost £40 for the circus and £30 for the candy floss and games. We  definitely wouldn't say it was worth it. Won't be coming back don't understand why this place is so popular? Also you have a time slot to enter but can stay as long as you like how do they manage to keep track of how many people are in there? title: Boring Snowman Experience at Hyde Park Winter Wonderland
review: Overall Winter Wonderland is very expensive. However, it is the Snowman Experience that was particularly disappointing and falls well short of the marketing description. What it actually is is the Snowman movie shown in 3 different rooms:Room 1 - below and to either side of the screen it is made to look like the inside of the house. But all that happens is that certain items of furniture are lit up when they appear on screen.Room 2 - the flying through the air part of the movie. Stand in front of a large curved screen. Watch middle part of movie in poor quality (fuzzy and pixelated) - difficult to see what is happening - whilst a light is shine in your face occasionally and a smoke machine effect is usedRoom 3 - sit either side of a double sided screen with a large table below set out for a party. This is lit up whilst the movie plays. A person dressed as a snowman walks through whilst the movie is playing and high fives the kids.That is it for £50+ for a family of four. Very poor. Expected much more interactivity and movement, e.g. a 4D experience with a 3D screen and moving seats, especially when flying.Very disappointing. Just watch the movie at home.

description: Open from Thursday 22 November 2018 to Sunday 6 January 2019, Winter Wonderland is the perfect place to celebrate the Christmas season.
title: Depressingly expensive
review: Most people expect London prices for food and drink but at Winter Wonderland this means £10 for a sausage in a bread roll or some potato slices on a stick - it's really a Wonderland for the traders. Where the rip off was most acute was the traditional style fairground games of 'hook a duck' or the target shooting game where there was simply no hiding the fact it was a borderline scam... The conversation with the 'hook a duck' operator was essentially, give me £7 and you can have this small toy or give me £14 and you can have the larger one - the act of hooking a duck was irrelevant. At the game where you had to knock a toy out of a square hole (which was the same size as the ball), one lady was elated to have actually achieved this, only to be told she had to do it twice to win.. and at the airgun target shooting game, I'm afraid £5 for three pellets is where I draw the line - these shameless rip offs really take the shine off the event and gets you into a money-watching mindset which you don't want to be in.  Elsewhere we saw huge queues for rides and we waited for half an hour in the queue for the real ice slide. When it eventually became clear we'd have to wait another 20-30 minutes before actually getting on the ice slope, we ditched the idea - even though we'd paid £20 for the tickets we called it a day and left the queue and went back to the hotel - resigned to the fact that we'd already been beaten up on costs so another £20 wouldn't make a difference. The one memorable attraction was the ice sculptures which were excellent, although we won't be back.

The porta potties could have used more frequent service as well. More handwashing washing stations or fill up those tanks for the portable sink more regularly.. also need more larger water jugs for the drinking station & less plastic cups. The booking and tickets on the app was easy, but surprisingly the add on’s for the after party tickets transferred to Ticketmaster. This was a surprise just before the event, which made it confusing for most after party attendees who had to download / locate the Ticketmaster app, struggle to log in or have to reset their passwords for another app during entry.

On the down side, I used "WeGotTickets" to book tickets to see Kerry Godliman back in November. Got to the venue last weekend, sat down only then to be told by the host she cancelled. We ended up leaving as it wasn't a short drive and the host was a bit cringe to be honest. Got in touch with WeGotTickets who advised they informed us of the cancellation and to check my spam folder. Nothing was there, the only email I ever received was the confirmation of my purchased tickets. I see a few people have had the same experience. Some responses from WeGotTickets also claim to text but I certainly didn't get one of those. Just seems very odd that they send the confirmation which goes straight into my inbox but the cancellation notice supposedly goes to a junk folder (which it didn't) So very disappointed to say the least however, as mentioned before, the communication and the attempted help was quick and can't fault them for trying, even if nothing was resolved and didn't get the outcome we hoped for. I would use WeGotTickets again but I will be double checking before we leave for the gig whether there will be any surprises. Wouldn't rely on the emails they send. Always check just in case. I have the screenshot. I mentioned about the issue with the transaction and who I should contact regarding a refund. Your support told me to contact the event organiser and made no reference to the issue about the second transaction nor did they offer to proactively address that with me via the live chat. But this stands to reason considering the fact they could not provide me with an updated start time for the event.Also, an access code which comes seperate to the link for the stream; implies you would need to enter the code to access the stream thus preventing the IP address of the device/ IP addresses you are using from being recorded then blocking you from using the device/IP address you intended to use in the first place.I've paid my money, but you're using your terms and conditions to cover for your terrible tech/system. If you're worth your salt and want to get repeat business then you should take the feedback onboard.Not everyone wants to read through 50 million terms and conditions before or after they make a purchase. If I use YouTube or any major streaming service, it's quite clear and easy to use. Your company is failing to grasp that in my opinion.Thanks for your response, but I've paid for a service that isn't fit for purpose.EDIT -#2:Okay, so basically your setup is flawless, myself and the event organiser need to be more careful before purchasing.Based on the fact that your help articles were all updated a week ago, I'm going to assume I'm not in the minority when it comes to issue with your policies and platform.Edit - #3:In light of Matthew Large from Glistrr reaching out to me directly to give feedback on my experience and his offer to refund me based on what I had explained regarding the unintended second purchase; I'm updating the review.In addition, I'm changing the rating from a 1 star to a 4 star. title: Poorly designed app
review: Poorly designed app. Tried to search for the event, search button didn't work and showed no results (this seems to happy every so often with the app). Next tried to locate it on my news feed however as you scroll down it reaches a certain point and then jumps back to the top again before you have scrolled through all of the available events, v fustrating. The app doesn't keep you logged in so you have to log back in again every time to make a purchase and even once you have completed your order my tickets are not showing in my list of tickets on the app. (Thankfully the confirmation email has them attached.) Worst ticket app I have used. Despite having used it numerous times this yr, none of those tickets are on my list of purchases on the app yet tickets I bought in 2019 are still showing. Wish they had an option to add event details to your phone calendar the way Eventbrite does as this is super handy. Whoever developed this app fell short.

title: Would not recommend
review: Sadly I would not recommend due to the experience. I purchased flooring from prime cook out and received email confirmation which said if you don’t hear from us it’s good news and it’s on its way. 9 days after purchasing I still hadn’t heard anything or received anything so I gave them a call. The gentleman I spoke with said that this wasn’t an order with them and I hadn’t purchased from them. I followed up with an email with proof of purchase. At this point I received a call back saying this was an Order with them and the flooring was out of stock and a refund had been completed the previous day. It was very disappointing that this hadn’t been communicated in anyway whatsoever and they were then telling me the refund would take up to ten days. In total they had my money for 14 days for a product they didn’t have in the first place and I only received an email regarding the refund two hours after my enquiry. It all felt like a bit of a scam and I was worried if I was going to get the money returned. If you were looking to purchase anything I would strongly suggest calling to make sure the product is in stock or at least they can get it in. Looking at others peoples issues it seems to be a reoccurring problem.

But I really shouldn't have had to contact them. We got tix for the Chicago Bears in London. I wasn't able to download their app in USA - no big deal, this is the case with lots of apps, figured I could do it when I arrived at UK. Couldn't do it. Said tix would be delivered to me Oct. 11 (game was 13th). Nope, no tix on Oct. 11. Three calls later, I finally got tix delivered to me. But it was a huge PITA to access them. Fortunately, the customer service person separately emailed me links to add the 6 tix directly to my Apple Wallet. Which worked. (I couldn’t access the tix through their website.) BUT I was unable to send the tix to others in my party (no the transfer between Apple Wallets didn't work). So we all had to go into the game thru 3 different scans of the tickets at the same time - was not able to distribute tix individually. Seems silly that this is the case in 2024. If we go again when Bears play in the future, I will not buy through Stubhub.uk or Stubhub.ie.

There was no clarification on how this amount was calculated and StubHub threatened legal action to take this amount. I’m now £100 out of pocket for no reason other than their predatory terms and condition practices. I had also emailed and called multiple times to get clarification and they claim that I never responded to their claim. On top of all of this they provided no details on how to pay the amount. Avoid like the plague.Update!!!Customer Service reached out to me after reviewing my case and have removed the administration fees. It took a fair bit of work (including this review) but a satisfactory end to a long process.

Unfortunately Stubhub has then ghosted me entirely. So much for 100% order guarantee. They say they'll resolve but then never get back to you again.Update: Recieved a call from Sarah one of their customer service agents. title: Just wait for other tickets to release elsewhere
review: NEVER BUY YOUR TICKETS HERE . Your tickets are “garunteed” by the day before, if not they refund you which is no use. On top of that I received my tickets as a link. I want to sell these tickets but nowhere accepts just a random link that I would still be able to access as sufficient. And on top of that, we are going to a packed venue with thousands of people, if data doesn’t work which it likely won’t then you just can’t load your ticket and get in. It’s insanity. How can you make people wait until the day before to not even garuntee them tickets and then on top of that, provide unsellable tickets that might not even work. Absolute disgrace. Never buy from here. Hands down the worst company I have ever purchased anything from ever. Update:Since posting this Stubhub got in contact and discussed my experience with me. I managed to sell one ticket and despite going through the creating a listing process twice, only one ticket was listed and therefore only one ticket sold. I was offered a refund for one ticket which i have since received which I do greatly appreciate. It was also mentioned that the link tickets are how they receive them which cannot negatively reflect on them however I disagree. Buying the tickets as a link is bad enough as the link may not load but also the link format is only re-sellable on stubhub. All other re-sale sights require a barcode, pdf or Ticketmaster transfer to resell and conveniently the only site that gives tickets in this format is the only site that accepts them in this format. Overall my experience has been slightly improved with receiving this refund but i will never understand how providing untransferable link tickets the day before an event is even legal. T upon seeing my review they were very persistent in rectifying the situation which is great to see but my experience up until that point was such a headache i wont be returning
